messages:
Jamie: Postmortem follow-up: we listed several action items during the bridge. Need to assign owners, create JIRAs, and set 2/6/12 week checkpoints. Scope: recurring ingestion-throttle spikes, stale LB configs, and missing canary rollback steps. Please claim items.

Keisha: I can take the ingestion-throttle RCA and short-term mitigation (rate cap + backpressure). Will create the ticket and add my initial notes.

Jonah: I'll own the LB config drift investigation and the automation to detect stale rules. Will open a JIRA with test cases.

Marco: I'll handle the canary rollback docs + deployment gating checklist. Aim for a PR in 10 business days.

infra-bot: JIRA created: RINF-3987 "Investigate ingestion throttle spikes during peak rebalances" assigned to Keisha. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3987

Keisha: Subtask RINF-3987-1 created: "collect ingestion traces + replay in staging". Tagging Jonah for correlation with LB events.

Jonah: Noted. I'll add a dashboard tile showing rule-change timestamps vs throttle spikes and propose alert RINF-3988.

Jamie: Proposed RACI for these items:
- Responsible: Keisha (ingestion), Jonah (LB drift), Marco (canary/rollback)
- Accountable: Jamie (remediation delivery)
- Consulted: Infra Eng, SRE Oncall
- Informed: Product + Support
Any objections?

Marco: Fine with that. Can we make RINF-3990 (canary gating) blocked-by RINF-3987 until ingestion replay validates behavior?

Keisha: Agree. Set blocked-by. Short-term ETA: apply a temporary rate cap this afternoon and post results.

Jonah: ETA: dashboard + draft alert rules by Wed EOD. Will include noise suppression (sla-flags).

Jamie: Checkpoints: 48h triage update, 2-week runbook + mitigations, 6-week automation, 12-week recurrence review. I'll add calendar invites for the checkpoints.

Keisha: I'll attach the replay steps and command snippets to RINF-3987. Example query: `select ts, ingestion_rate, throttle_count from ingest_metrics where throttle_count > 0 order by ts desc limit 100`.

infra-bot: Subtask created: RINF-3987-1 "replay ingestion traces in staging" assigned to Keisha.

Jamie: Summary of action items:
- RINF-3987: ingestion throttle RCA  Owner: Keisha (R); subtask created.
- RINF-3988: LB drift detection & alerts  Owner: Jonah (R).
- RINF-3990: canary gating & rollback checklist  Owner: Marco (C); blocked-by RINF-3987.

Jamie: Please update JIRAs with PR links and status. We'll reconvene 48 hours after the dashboard/alert draft to validate thresholds. If blockers pop up, escalate to oncall.

Keisha: Starting work and will post quick updates here. :thumbsup:

Jonah: Will post dashboard link and alert queries when ready.

Marco: Will draft the rollback checklist and attach to RINF-3990.

Jamie: Thanks all, closing thread. Update here if anything changes.
